name: ESCloseAlignedAggressorFlow-v1

signal.rth_move: ES.v.0 09:30 one-minute open to 15:29 one-minute close, America/New_York
signal.large_move: absolute RTH move >= trailing 60 eligible-session sample standard deviation, shifted one session
signal.flow: ES.v.0 buyer-aggressor volume minus seller-aggressor volume from 15:00:00 through 15:29:59.999 ET
signal.entry_spread: MES.v.0 ask minus bid <= 0.25 at first MBP-1 record at/after 15:30:05 ET
signal.exit: first MES.v.0 MBP-1 record at/after 15:59:45 ET

exclusions: RTH bar count is not exactly 390
Databento condition is degraded on the study weekday
ES bar and trade continuous mappings disagree
MES entry and exit continuous mappings disagree
fewer than 60 prior eligible sessions for volatility normalization
controls: large price move plus one-tick spread
large price move with opposed aggressive flow

statistics.interaction_test: one-sided permutation test of aligned minus opposed mean net MES P&L

development_gate: positive mean net P&L at $1.24 round-trip commission
live_recommendation_gate: positive holdout mean net P&L at $1.24 commission
positive holdout aligned-minus-opposed mean net P&L
lower bound of holdout month-clustered 95% confidence interval for mean net P&L is positive
